summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of Makallakap (Turkish proverbs, Expo/React Native web preview). Verified all listed flows: Home, Browse (search 'sabır'=20 results, 'at' works, clear, LetterRail jump), Proverb Detail (ANLAMI/AÇIKLAMASI, TTS/Share/Fav action bar, back), Favorites toggle + AsyncStorage persistence, Categories (22 cards with counts, opens category-list with 43 items for 'Aile'), Quiz (3 modes, 10 questions, results with restart/home, achievement 'İlk Quiz' 1/1 unlocked), Achievements (streak card + 8 badges), Settings (theme/accent/font-size/font-family segmented + notif-switch reveals time steppers), Recent empty state, Turkish characters (ğ,ı,İ,ş,ö,ç,ü) render correctly, and Günün Atasözü is deterministic on reload. All settings persist across reload (dark theme + Altın accent + Büyük font size confirmed after full reload). No crashes, no red screen, no non-Turkish UI strings found. Only harmless console warnings from react-native-web (deprecated shadow* props, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver — no action needed).
critical_code_review_comments: Recent screen: `recent-clear-button` is intentionally rendered only when there are recent items (verified in code) — spec-compliant.
Settings: `hour-up/down/min-up/min-down` are only rendered when `notif-switch` is enabled — spec-compliant and verified.

React-native-web console warnings ('shadow*' deprecated, `pointerEvents` deprecated, `useNativeDriver` missing) originate from libraries (expo-linear-gradient/expo-image/Animated) and are harmless on web preview; no user-visible impact.
seed_data_creation: None — offline app with bundled proverbs.json (3512 entries).
